name: @pipeworx/mcp-mic

tools.name: decode_mic
tools.description: Decode an ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) — the 4-character venue code openfigi returns as `exchCode` on an exchange listing, and the code most market-data feeds use the same way — to the trading venue's own name, legal operator, country, city, website and registry status. Reports whether the code is an OPERATING MIC (the operator as a whole, e.g. "XNYS") or a SEGMENT MIC (one specific market under an operator, e.g. "ARCX" under "XNYS"); an operating MIC also carries segment_count — call search_mics with operating_mic to list them.

code.description: 4-character ISO 10383 MIC, e.g. "XNYS" (NYSE) or "XLON" (London Stock Exchange).

tools.name: search_mics
tools.description: Filter the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code registry by country, operating MIC, status and/or a name fragment. Returns aggregate counts first (total matched, by_status, by_country) and a page of rows after. Use operating_mic to list every segment market under one venue operator (e.g. every segment under "XNYS").

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the venue, e.g. "US", "GB", "JP".

operating_mic.description: List every market (segment or operating) under this operating MIC, e.g. "XNYS" to list NYSE's own segments.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive fragment of the market name, legal entity name or acronym, e.g. "nasdaq".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mic forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mic pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
